entities.label: My one-person company
entities.owns: General software, consulting offers, media, consumer products.

entities.label: Day job
entities.owns: Everything about the employer's systems, data, and vendors. Out of scope here.
entities.notes: Present in the profile so items can be routed away from the personal backlog, not so they can be worked on.

goals.statement: Sell three fixed-scope diagnostic engagements to small B2B software companies.
goals.success_looks_like: Three paid orders from fifty individually researched prospects.
goals.kill_criteria: Fifty qualified, personalized contacts produce no paid order and no strong implementation opportunity.

goals.statement: Publish evidence-led writing on a sustainable cadence.
goals.success_looks_like: Six issues shipped, median production time trending down, at least one attributable conversation.
goals.kill_criteria: Four issues produce no subscribers, replies, or conversations worth having.

goals.statement: Run a weekly read-only review of money in and money out.
goals.success_looks_like: Six consecutive weekly reviews, each surfacing at least one thing worth acting on.
goals.kill_criteria: The review is skipped three weeks running.

goals.statement: Establish whether AI coding assistance actually lowers total reviewed delivery cost.
goals.success_looks_like: One tool measured against a baseline on a bounded task, with review minutes recorded.
goals.kill_criteria: No measurable difference after two bounded tests.

license_requirements: Must permit commercial use for anything sold.
Must permit publishing research derived from it, for anything that feeds writing.
data_boundaries: No employer data leaves employer systems.
No customer personal data in any experiment.
No credentials in any tool that has not had a security review.
excluded_subjects: Compliance and governance product intellectual property, which belongs to a separate company.

vetoes.condition: There is no lawful and terms-compliant way to use it.
Requires handing credentials or customer data to something unreviewed.
vetoes.rationale: The downside is unbounded and not recoverable.

vetoes.condition: The license bars the use the goal requires, including publishing derived work.
vetoes.rationale: Found late, this invalidates finished work.

vetoes.condition: Holds data with no export and no rollback.
vetoes.rationale: A trial you cannot leave is not a trial.

vetoes.condition: The economic case rests entirely on unverified claims.
vetoes.rationale: Frequency across accounts is not corroboration.
